entries.title: Psalms 101:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> I will sing of mercy and justice; To You, O LORD, I will sing praises.

entries.title: Psalms 101:2
segments: I will behave wisely in a perfect way. Oh, when will You come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

entries.title: Psalms 101:3
segments: I will set nothing wicked before my eyes; I hate the work of those who fall away; It shall not cling to me.

entries.title: Psalms 101:4
segments: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will not know wickedness.

entries.title: Psalms 101:5
segments: Whoever secretly slanders his neighbor, Him I will destroy; The one who has a haughty look and a proud heart, Him I will not endure.

entries.title: Psalms 101:6
segments: My eyes [shall be] on the faithful of the land, That they may dwell with me; He who walks in a perfect way, He shall serve me.

entries.title: Psalms 101:7
segments: He who works deceit shall not dwell within my house; He who tells lies shall not continue in my presence.

entries.title: Psalms 101:8
segments: Early I will destroy all the wicked of the land, That I may cut off all the evildoers from the city of the LORD.
